properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Functions: Managed Identity Required
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Function Apps without a managed identity (system-assigned or user-assigned). FedRAMP High requires organizational users to be uniquely identified and authenticated (IA-2). Managed identities eliminate credential storage in code and enable Azure RBAC-based service-to-service authentication for function bindings and triggers.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Function Apps without managed identity. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
